::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

data(penguins)
one <- penguins |>
  filter(species == params$species, !is.na(bill_len), !is.na(bill_dep))
```
:::


This report covers **Gentoo** penguins only. It was built by passing `species` as a
**parameter**, so the *same* source file renders one report per species — change the parameter, not
the document.
